topics.title: Family Reunion Radio Mystery
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, callers discuss an unusual relationship with their brother and sister who met at a family reunion. The conversation reveals they are separated by sixteen years but have developed feelings for each other despite not having known one another before, sharing details about their lives including jobs and marriages.

topics.title: Family Secrets and Confusions
topics.summary: A caller recounts a complicated family situation involving her brother, his wife (also her sister), and their children, exploring the awkwardness of their relationships while considering media opportunities for the story.

topics.title: Kate’s Wild Proposition
topics.summary: During an interview, Kate proposes a scheme to her agent involving publishing deals and leveraging the success of British television personalities like Jessica Hahn. She suggests capitalizing on potential TV series opportunities in England while aiming for lucrative contracts with American publishers, ultimately seeking substantial income through various ventures including celebrity endorsements.

topics.title: Stern Interviews Moody Blues & Topless Bank Report
topics.summary: Howard Stern interviews Graham Edge of the Moody Blues while discussing a new topless bank in Fort Lauderdale that sells Coca-Cola and souvenirs alongside financial services. A murder investigation involving a hunchbacked lover overdosing after killing Tessa Davis is also reported, adding an unusual element to the broadcast.

topics.title: Moody Blues Drummer Discusses Personal Life and Groupies
topics.summary: During a radio interview, Moody Blues drummer recounts his tumultuous personal life including multiple divorces, an affair with a film star’s wife, and encounters with groupies during the band's early days. He details meeting women on tour and discusses his daughter being born during this period.

topics.title: Moodle Blues and Family Discord
topics.summary: During an interview, the speaker expresses skepticism about analyzing drawings as ‘cosmic gurus’ while criticizing Paul McCartney’s behavior regarding Linda and his wife’s marital issues. The conversation shifts to family dynamics including perceived lack of answers from a spouse, revealing frustrations with personal relationships.
